goals.criterion: Complete the existing autonomous operating loop with independently verified session, continuation and actual runtime ownership

acceptance_criteria: Both suites use immutable exact collection manifests and bounded serial batches; complete actual node accounting is required before success; no dropped tests or silent policy change.
Timeout/failure/cancel preserves diagnostic evidence and owns process cleanup; failed/unknown checks never become approval and fencing remains intact.
Actual tiny pytest-process tests cover complete/empty/failed collection, parameterized IDs, missing/duplicate/unexpected coverage, skips, timeout logs and compatible existing release behavior.
Consolidated lead correction: redact every node-derived persisted field, retain collection/fence interruption report, and bound cleanup after failed tree termination with unknown outcome.
